parts.name: T-Slot Channel Side Tap
parts.description: Machining service that taps a 1/4-20 hole in the T-slot channel of a 15 series profile at a custom location along its length, specified from the left end of the profile.
features: Provides tapped hole in T-slot channel at custom locations along length of profile
Taps through center cavity of profile; does not tap through close-faced profile sides or multiple cavities at once
parts.notes: Reference page 11-16. Specify location from the left end of profile and the T-slot letter per the T-Slot Channel Tap Designations diagram. Note: For profiles with open center cavities, taps on opposite facing T-slots will not align for thread use through entire profile. Metric-profile counterparts: 30-7702, 40-7702, 45-7702. Ordering Example: (3) 1530 x 75.00 w/ #7702 in slot F at 2.00”.

parts.name: Deluxe Door Handle Profile Milling
parts.description: Machining service that counterbores and drills a 15 series profile, with 10-32 tapped holes above and below the centerline, so the deluxe door handle (pg. 5-116) can be mounted to a T-slot profile.
features: Required when using the deluxe door handle (pg. 5-116) to a T-slot profile
When ordering, designate distance from the end of profile to the centerline (CL)

specs.Service Type: Drill Thru Hole for Deluxe Door Handle

parts.dimension_notes: Drawing: ø .875” x .500” Deep (22.23mm x 12.70mm) counterbore with ø .500” Thru (12.70mm) hole on the centerline (CL), plus a 10-32 Tap at .750” (19.05mm) above and below CL.
parts.notes: Reference page 11-17. Positioning Example shows the CL 4.000” (101.60mm) from the end of a 24.000” (609.60mm) profile, in T-slot B. T-slot letters per the Deluxe Door Handle Machining Designations diagram. Metric counterpart: 65-7305 (40 series, ø 22.23mm x (12.70mm)). Ordering Example: (1) 1515 x 24.00” w/ #7305 in B @ 4.00” from left end.

parts.name: Furniture Style Handle Profile Milling
parts.description: Machining service that drills a profile so the furniture style door handle (pg. 5-118) can be mounted to a T-slot profile.
features: Required when using the furniture style door handle (pg. 5-118) to a T-slot profile
When ordering, designate distance from the end of profile to the centerline (CL)

specs.Service Type: Drill Thru Hole for Furniture Style Handle

parts.dimension_notes: Drawing: ø .813” x .390” Deep (20.62mm x 9.91mm) counterbore with ø .390” Thru (9.91mm) hole on the centerline (CL), plus ø .181” Thru (4.60mm) holes at .750” (19.05mm) above and below CL.
parts.notes: Reference page 11-18. Part number is printed as 7315* with footnote: *The counterbore is only for the 10 and 25 series. Row is badged 10 and 15. Per the footnote, the counterbore (Bore Size (Depth) column) applies to 10 and 25 series only, not to 15 series profiles. Table lists bore ø .812” while the drawing labels it ø .813”. Positioning Example shows the CL 4.000” (101.60mm) from the end of a 24.000” (609.60mm) profile, in T-slot B. T-slot letters per the Furniture Style Handle Machining Designations diagram. Metric counterpart: 65-7315* (25 and 40 series, ø 20.62mm x (9.91mm)). Ordering Example: (1) 1515 x 24.00” w/ #7315 in B @ 4.00” from left end.

parts.name: Miter Connector Profile Milling
parts.description: Machining service that drills and counterbores a mitered 15 series profile end for the miter connector (pg. 4-19), with depths and offsets given for bar cut angles from 7.5º to 45º.
features: Required when using the miter connector (pg. 4-19) for a profile connection
parts.dimension_notes: ANG = Bar Cut Angle (0-45); A = ø.394 (10mm) Drill Depth (ø .394” x “A” Deep); B = ø.597 (15.16mm) C-bore from Miter Tip; C = Counterbore Depth (ø .597” x “C” Deep); D = Miter Offset; E = Center of Bar. Drawing also shows 1.439” (36.55mm) and 1.858” (47.20mm) reference dimensions.
parts.notes: Reference page 11-19. Spec values are the 15 series columns of the Miter Connector Profile Milling table; table also lists 40 and 45 series values. Metric counterparts: 40-7110, 45-7110. T-slot letters per the Miter Connector Machining Designations diagram.

features: Required when using the central connector (pg. 4-20); consists of drill through the profile end and counterbore

specs.Service Type: 15 Series Profile Milling for Central Connector

parts.dimension_notes: Counterbore is ø B x E Deep; A = distance from the profile end to the counterbore center; C = diameter of the bore drilled into the profile end (section view); D = depth of that bore from the profile end.

corrected: 7305: description 'drills and counterbores ...' -> adds the 10-32 tapped holes shown on the drawing
7315: notes added explicit statement that the counterbore applies only to 10 and 25 series (per footnote), not to 15 series

7058: dimension_notes 'C and D are dimensions of the end drill-through ... (D measured from the profile end)' -> 'C = diameter of the bore drilled into the profile end; D = depth of that bore from the profile end' (confirmed on section view)
remaining_doubts: 7315 is printed as '7315*'; the asterisk was treated as a footnote marker and dropped from part_number (footnote kept in notes).
7305/7315 dimension_notes assume the second hole at .750” below CL is the same feature (10-32 tap / ø .181” thru) as the labelled upper hole; the drawing labels only the upper one.

7244, 7246, 7248 (p. 11-14) and 7241, 7243, 7245 (p. 11-15) are also badged 10 series, and 7315 is badged 10 and 15; only 15 (plus RT for 7246) is recorded in series, per the rules, with the 10 badge mentioned in notes.
